title: Hot CPI knocks Bitcoin to $73K as $632M gets liquidated, PPI Friday
caption:
hotter october cpi knocked btc to ~$73.4k 📉 cpi +0.4% vs 0.3% expected, december hike odds 85%. eth -3.7%, sol -4%+. $632m liquidated in 24h, ~80% longs. btc etfs -$201m monday, 3rd straight outflow day. jobless claims thu, ppi fri. not financial advice.
